subject: Quick follow-up: demo time options + security & procurement intro
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acme-retail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap — next steps

Hi Logan — thanks for the call today. Quick recap and request:

- Goal: evaluate Redwood for API-driven inference for customer support routing and dynamic summarization (pilot, then expand).
- Primary stakeholders: Product (me), Platform (Tom in procurement loop), Security (we'll need SOC2 / data flow doc), Eng (will join technical deep dive).

Can we schedule the demo/technical deep dive next week (30–45 min)? My team is available on the windows below (PST):

- Tue 11/17: 10:00–11:30
- Wed 11/18: 09:00–12:00
- Thu 11/19: 14:00–16:00

Please loop in the right folks from your side (security/solutions engineering) and share any prep material we should review. Also attaching a short list of our procurement checklist items.

Attachments: procurement-checklist-acme.xlsx (xlsx, referenced)

Thanks,
Sarah
Product Lead — Acme Retail
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap — next steps

Thanks Sarah — great to chat. High level: we can cover architecture, security controls, quantization/cost tradeoffs, and a short live demo for your use case. Proposed next steps below:

- Proposed demo slots (pick one):
  • Tue 11/17 10:30–11:15 PST
  • Wed 11/18 09:30–10:15 PST
  • Thu 11/19 14:30–15:15 PST

- I'll have Marissa lead the technical walkthrough and Karthik cover deployment/ops specifics (VPC, dedicated vs hosted choices).
- I've attached a short product sheet and our SOC2 summary for your security team to skim ahead of the call.

Attachments: redwood-product-sheet.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

If Tom (procurement) is able to confirm one of those slots, we'll lock it in and circulate a calendar invite + agenda.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acme-retail.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, procurement@acme-retail.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 12:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro call recap — next steps

Adding a quick note from the solutions engineering side — happy to run the demo and cover security-relevant items. Proposed agenda (30–45 min):

1) 5m — Quick product fit recap and success metrics you care about
2) 15–20m — Live demo: sample prompts, latency/cost tradeoffs, embeddings for routing
3) 10–15m — Deployment options: hosted API vs dedicated pools vs private VPC, data flow, access controls
4) 5–10m — Q&A + next steps (POC kickoff, mutual action plan)

Prep requests (optional):
- A sample (redacted) customer transcript or a short prompt set if you want us to demo against your patterns
- Any security checklist items we should prioritize in the call (Tom — cc'd)

Two quick asks from procurement/security side before the demo so we can bring the right folks:
1) Can you send a short answers doc (5–6 bullets) about data residency and retention policy specific to hosted offering?
2) Is there a link to your security questionnaire or a quick SOC2 summary we can share?

I've gone ahead and penciled Wed 11/18 09:30–10:15 PST on our calendar; please send the invite and agenda.

Thanks,
